notes: COVERAGE LIMITED: the session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was used up before this account was processed, so step 1 (Instagram search snippets), step 3 (paid-partnership / storefront searches) and step 4 (the 3 reel searches) could NOT be run. This profile uses only (a) the project's own captures of public Instagram pages made earlier on 2026-09-25 (topic pages instagram.com/popular/<topic>/ and reel embed pages), and (b) direct WebFetch of public Threads / Linktree / Beacons URLs plus a YouTube channel lookup (NexLev MCP). No new request to instagram.com was made. Fetch results: Threads = public profile (see bio_source); linktr.ee/naturesms = HTTP 404; beacons.ai/naturesms = HTTP 403 (inconclusive, not retried). The Threads account was active on 2026-09-25, with 4 posts inside 24 hours, for example 'Two lovers, longing for each other, gazing at the same moon, can now be considered as reunited.' (#moon #healing #scenery). These posts drew only 22-43 likes each against 5.9M Threads followers. Instagram performance: likes on the embed pages were 17,805 (DMfmp0gScp0), 9,250 (DbTRDeMyaOy), 8,414 (DQUUZF-EpAX) and 4,188 (DTnOUBCkiKU). Views on the topic pages ranged from 133K to 1.3M, a median of 386K, which is only about 0.025x the 10M followers (accounts_metrics.csv). Reach per follower is very low for its size, which points to an old, large and now under-reaching audience. The sampled reels span 2024-09-12 to 2026-07-27 (decoded from shortcodes).
